name: OwningMembership
definition: A membership in which an owning element owns another element.

name: FeatureMembership
definition: A membership that relates an element to a feature.

name: FeatureTyping
definition: A relationship that specifies the type of a feature.

name: Subsetting
definition: A relationship in which one feature is a subset of another.

name: Redefinition
definition: A relationship in which one feature redefines another feature.
